name: 55347 · Eden Prairie, MN
findings: ZIP 55347 (Eden Prairie) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55347 (Eden Prairie) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
